name: Tolemite
description: The Tolemites were a sentient species native to the Wild Space planet Tolis. Living around twenty thousand years before the High Republic Era, the Tolemites were steeped in the Force, which they worshiped as the Peace. During an expedition, the Tolemites discovered the homeworld of the Force-draining creatures later known as the Nameless, bringing some of the beings back to Tolis. However, when the Nameless were removed from their home, the creatures were transformed and corrupted by their hunger and instead fed on the Tolemites. The Nameless, as well as the affliction known as the blight, destroyed the Tolemites' civilization. The surviving Tolemites retreated, constructing three rods using Echo Stones that were used by the Three Ancients to control the Nameless, leading the creatures back to their home.
